# Downloading several saved reviews together

In **Downloads**, select the loads under **Download a group of saved reviews**,
then choose **Download selected reviews**. You can choose 1–100 loads; the archive
keeps their displayed order. **Select all available** selects the readable,
unambiguous packets when there are no more than 100. This selection lives in
the open page and does not save or change a reviewer decision.

Unzip the downloaded file and open its `index.html`. Each link opens the existing
saved-review cover, including the original packet, selected-load report records,
saved note and history. The five original member files and the exact original
single-load ZIP are retained under an ordinal directory such as `loads/0001/`.
Load labels and download filenames never become archive directory names.
The batch manifest records every selected identity and all member byte counts
and SHA-256 checksums.

The server checks all displayed packet/report and saved-review identities under
the same existing review lock. One changed, missing or ambiguous selected record
refuses the entire batch. It does not silently omit that load or refresh its review.
Downloading does not initialize or rerun the pipeline and writes no review,
input, report or archive into the server output directory.

Save or undo current note edits and wait for a review or pipeline update before
downloading. **Cancel batch download** stops a pending request. Selection edits,
note edits and review or pipeline actions discard a pending reply. A refresh
that changes a selected identity clears the selection and asks you to inspect
and select the current records again; changes to unselected loads retain it.
A failed download makes no automatic retry and leaves saved reviews unchanged.

Unreviewed, cleared, stale, unbound and current decisions keep the meanings of the
existing per-load covers. The batch is a local draft snapshot, with no combined
payment total or new approval. Nothing is sent, invoiced or paid.
